name: the-hard-parts
description: Senior-specialist skills that design AND build production-hardened backend systems: normalized API response contracts, cold-start / first-load optimization, event-driven pipelines, idempotency systems, rate limiting and quotas, resilience (timeouts/retries/circuit breakers), caching strategy, and auth flows. Each skill gathers context (inspecting your codebase first), applies a battle-tested reference design, and produces an HTML or Markdown deliverable plus real implementation artifacts. Includes per-skill slash commands and a /hard-parts discovery command.
